def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # The separator is a uniform row or column.
    sep_col = next(
        (c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))),
        None
    )
    if sep_col is not None:
        n = sep_col
        right = [grid[r][sep_col + 1:sep_col + 1 + n] for r in range(h)]
        from collections import Counter
        background = Counter(x for row in right for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
        return [
            [3 if grid[r][c] == right[r][c] else background for c in range(n)]
            for r in range(h)
        ]

    sep_row = next(r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1)
    n = sep_row
    bottom = grid[sep_row + 1:sep_row + 1 + n]
    from collections import Counter
    background = Counter(x for row in bottom for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [
        [3 if grid[r][c] == bottom[r][c] else background for c in range(w)]
        for r in range(n)
    ]

def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Find the uniform separator and compare the two panels cell by cell.
    sep_row = next((r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1), None)
    sep_col = next((c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1), None)

    if sep_row is not None:
        top = grid[:sep_row]
        bottom = grid[sep_row + 1:sep_row + 1 + len(top)]
        background = Counter(v for row in bottom for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
        return [
            [3 if top[r][c] == bottom[r][c] else background for c in range(w)]
            for r in range(len(top))
        ]

    left = [row[:sep_col] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep_col + 1:sep_col + 1 + sep_col] for row in grid]
    background = Counter(v for row in right for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [
        [3 if left[r][c] == right[r][c] else background for c in range(sep_col)]
        for r in range(h)
    ]

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # The separator divides the grid into two equal-sized panels.
    sep = None
    for r in range(h):
        if r == h - r - 1 and len(set(grid[r])) == 1:
            sep = ("row", r)
            break
    if sep is None:
        for c in range(w):
            if c == w - c - 1 and all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)):
                sep = ("col", c)
                break

    if sep[0] == "row":
        r = sep[1]
        a, b = grid[:r], grid[r + 1:]
        shared = set(x for row in a for x in row) & set(x for row in b for x in row)
        color = next(iter(shared))
        return [[3 if a[i][j] == color and b[i][j] == color else color
                 for j in range(w)] for i in range(r)]

    c = sep[1]
    a = [row[:c] for row in grid]
    b = [row[c + 1:] for row in grid]
    shared = set(x for row in a for x in row) & set(x for row in b for x in row)
    color = next(iter(shared))
    return [[3 if a[i][j] == color and b[i][j] == color else color
             for j in range(c)] for i in range(h)]
